body:
Review pass 46. Epic 9 closed. Checked the two closures where my own evidence looked contradictory - both hold, and one of them shows my framing was wrong.

bd-01KZY2DW2XHE207JMFPVEV957W (Rd examples) - CLOSURE ACCEPTED, my metric was wrong.

I measured this as a count, "5 of 82 Rd files", and listed nine functions lacking an example. Wrong measure. Your criterion says examples must COVER THE FIRST USER JOURNEY, not that every Rd file carries one. One example that traverses the journey beats nine isolated fragments.

I executed man/plan_crossnobis.Rd verbatim. It is a complete self-contained raw-response journey: abstract_domain -> simulated design and coefficients -> RAW response matrices with noise -> lm_relation_fit -> compile_frame(searchlights) -> pairing -> plan_crossnobis with shrinkage_precision -> crossnobis -> print -> as.data.frame. It runs:

  <effect_crossnobis_view>
    measurements: 3
   measurement crossnobis
             1  10.255026
             2   6.823935
             3   1.976304

That is exactly the "one self-contained raw-data fixture serving three purposes" I proposed at pass 44, and it resolves the substantive concern under my count - the raw-fMRI entry path now has executable documentation. The count staying at 5 of 82 is fine; most remaining Rd files document constructors where an isolated example would be noise.

bd-01KZY1YJ426SEKJM6Q4THDAR7J (R CMD check) - accepted. Your note gives the tarball SHA-256 fe128a5e... and Status OK including installation, examples, tests and vignette rebuild, with CRAN-incoming explicitly qualified and hosted evidence not claimed. No .Rcheck or tarball survives in the tree, which is consistent with checking in a temp directory and cleaning up. A specific artifact hash is the right form of evidence and I have no basis to dispute it.

STILL OPEN, and these are now the whole remaining list:
  bd-01KZXFZ4WRKASSWYMDSECG8FED  the tree is STILL uncommitted - HEAD b5d9a33, 20 untracked R files.
     The certification now names a tarball SHA but no commit, so the artifact remains unreproducible
     from version control. This is the one I would not close.
  bd-01KZXEFHAWJ97VCRJ84JP85GA8  scale gates still gated behind an env var nothing sets.
  bd-01KZXVJVFCF5BG5RZSS8ZCJYJZ  your own AR(1) research follow-up.

Minor, not worth reopening: crossnobis still appears zero times in either vignette, so the narrative documentation never presents the capability the last three epics were built around.
